question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108.0B +/-2% (Q2 FY27 8-K, excludes China DC compute). Over the last 8 quarters actual revenue beat the guidance midpoint by +2.5% to +7.9% (mean ~5%, e.g., Q2 FY27 $96.2B vs $91.0B guide = +5.7%). Applying that beat distribution gives a median near $113B. Sell-side consensus (~$108.8-109B) mostly mirrors guidance. Upside: faster Vera Rubin ramp or a China reopening; downside: supply limits or revenue-timing slips. No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold contract on Nvidia Q3 revenue was found (Polymarket only lists share-price markets). Report confirmed for Nov 17, 2026.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same evidence (guide $108B ±2%, 8-quarter beat history of +2.5% to +7.9%, report date Nov 17) and nearly identical medians (~$113.0-113.2B). Disputes: (1) upper-escape mass 7% vs 11%. This is judgment. Older quarters (Q4 FY24 to Q3 FY25) had beats above 7.4%, recent ones did not, and the Rubin ramp and China are upside optionality, so I took 10%. (2) The Q1 FY27 guide figure (~$78B) is unverified; I could not check it without web access, and it is immaterial to the beat distribution. (3) Consensus varies by tracker ($108.8-111.4B); this is not material. Percentiles are conditional on landing in range, so after removing 10% upper mass they shift slightly below the runs' figures. I retrieved no sources myself.

disagreements.verdict: Set at 10%: older beats above 7.4% exist; recent beats are smaller; Rubin and China give upside optionality
